image_prompts: A whiteboard with the word 'ADJ' written in blue marker, surrounded by colorful sticky notes labeled 'beautiful', 'fast', 'happy'
A grammar textbook open to a page titled 'Adjectives' with examples like 'tall building' and 'cold water' underlined in red
words.image_desc_en: A whiteboard with 'ADJ' and sticky notes of adjectives; a grammar book page on adjectives.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块写着'ADJ'的白板，贴满形容词便签；一本语法书打开到形容词章节。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数形式为 adjs)
words.collocations: an adj (一个形容词), use an adj (使用形容词), describe with an adj (用形容词描述)
words.preposition_combos: adj for (适合……的形容词), adj of (……的形容词)

examples.en: In the sentence 'a red apple', 'red' is an adj.
examples.cn: 在句子'a red apple'中，'red'是一个形容词。

examples.en: We often use an adj to describe a noun.
examples.cn: 我们经常用形容词来描述名词。

socratic_questions.question: 在英语课上，老师说'beautiful'、'tall'、'happy'这些词都属于同一类词，用来修饰名词。这类词叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这类词是形容词，缩写为adj，用来描述人或事物的特征。

sentences: In grammar, 'big' is an ___ that describes size.

image_prompts: A bowl of fresh fruit on a wooden table with a small sign reading 'Natural Goodness'
A jar of honey labeled 'Pure Goodness' next to a spoon dripping golden honey
words.image_desc_en: A fruit bowl with a 'Natural Goodness' sign; a honey jar labeled 'Pure Goodness' with dripping honey.
words.image_desc_cn: 一碗水果旁有'天然营养'的牌子；一瓶蜂蜜标着'纯正精华'，蜂蜜正滴落。
words.meaning_cn: 善良；精华；营养（感叹词：天哪）
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)；也可作感叹词 interj.
words.collocations: thank goodness (谢天谢地), goodness knows (天知道), for goodness' sake (看在老天份上)

examples.en: Thank goodness! The rain stopped before our picnic.
examples.cn: 谢天谢地！雨在我们野餐前停了。

examples.en: The goodness of fresh vegetables is good for health.
examples.cn: 新鲜蔬菜的营养对健康有益。

socratic_questions.question: 你考试通过了，非常开心，想表达'谢天谢地'，应该用哪个词开头？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 用'Thank goodness'，表示庆幸和感激。

sentences: ___! I found my lost wallet under the desk.

image_prompts: A wooden toolbox with a hammer, screwdriver, and wrench arranged neatly inside
A set of colorful plastic geometry tools (ruler, protractor, compass) on a white desk
words.image_desc_en: A wooden toolbox with hammer and screwdriver; colorful geometry tools on a white desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个木制工具箱里整齐放着锤子和螺丝刀；白色桌面上放着彩色几何工具。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数形式 tools)
words.collocations: a useful tool (有用的工具), a tool box (工具箱), use a tool (使用工具)
words.preposition_combos: tool for (用于……的工具), tool of (……的工具)

examples.en: A dictionary is a helpful tool for learning English.
examples.cn: 词典是学习英语的有用工具。

examples.en: My father keeps his tools in a red box.
examples.cn: 我父亲把他的工具放在一个红色箱子里。

socratic_questions.question: 你想修好一把椅子，需要锤子和螺丝刀，这些东西统称什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这些东西叫工具（tool），用来完成修理工作。

sentences: A computer is a powerful ___ for students to do research.

image_prompts: A calendar with a circled date and a red cross over a previous wrong date, with the word 'Actually' written next to it
A signpost pointing in two directions, one labeled 'Wrong Way' crossed out, the other labeled 'Correct Way' with 'Actually' arrow
words.image_desc_en: A calendar with a corrected date and 'Actually' note; a signpost with 'Wrong Way' crossed out and 'Actually' pointing to correct path.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上纠正了日期并写着'Actually'；路标上'错误方向'被划掉，'Actually'指向正确方向。
words.meaning_cn: 实际上；事实上（用于纠正或强调）
words.usage: adv. (副词，常用于句首或句中)
words.collocations: actually think (实际上认为), actually mean (实际意思是), actually happen (实际发生)

examples.en: I thought the test was hard, but actually it was easy.
examples.cn: 我以为考试很难，但实际上很简单。

examples.en: He said he was busy, but actually he was playing games.
examples.cn: 他说他很忙，但实际上他在玩游戏。

socratic_questions.question: 你朋友以为今天是周三，但你知道今天是周四，你想纠正他，可以用哪个词开头？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 用'Actually'，表示'实际上'，用来纠正错误信息。

sentences: She looks young, but ___ she is over forty years old.

image_prompts: A basketball flying through a hoop with net swishing, gymnasium background, bright lighting
A camera on a tripod with a red record button pressed, video timeline bars on a monitor
words.image_desc_en: A basketball going through a hoop with net movement; a camera recording with a pressed button.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个篮球穿过篮筐，网摆动；一台摄像机按下录制按钮。
words.meaning_cn: v. 投篮；拍摄（照片/视频）
words.usage: v. (过去式 shot, 过去分词 shot)
words.collocations: shoot a basket, shoot a video, shoot photos

examples.en: He can shoot three-pointers from far away.
examples.cn: 他能从远处投三分球。

examples.en: We will shoot a short film for the class project.
examples.cn: 我们将为班级项目拍摄一部短片。

socratic_questions.question: 在篮球比赛中，你想把球扔进篮筐得分，这个动作叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作和“发射”有关，篮球术语中常用这个词表示投篮。

sentences: The player ___ the ball and scored two points.

image_prompts: A sun rising over a calm ocean horizon, golden light spreading across the water
A magician's hat on a table with a white rabbit popping out, stage spotlight
words.image_desc_en: A sun rising above the ocean; a rabbit emerging from a magician's hat.
words.image_desc_cn: 太阳从海平面升起；一只兔子从魔术师帽子里出现。
words.usage: v. (过去式 appeared, 过去分词 appeared)
words.collocations: appear in, appear on, appear to be

examples.en: A rainbow appeared after the heavy rain stopped.
examples.cn: 大雨停后，一道彩虹出现了。

examples.en: Your name will appear on the list tomorrow.
examples.cn: 你的名字明天会出现在名单上。

socratic_questions.question: 雨过天晴，天空突然多了一道彩色弧线，这个现象用哪个词描述？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“从看不见变成看得见”，彩虹就是突然出现的。

sentences: The moon ___ in the dark sky after sunset.

image_prompts: An open library door with a sign reading 'Welcome' in warm colors, bookshelves inside
A coffee cup on a table with a note saying 'Help yourself' next to a plate of cookies
words.image_desc_en: An open library door with a welcome sign; a coffee cup and a note saying 'Help yourself' with cookies.
words.image_desc_cn: 一扇敞开的图书馆门，上有欢迎标志；一杯咖啡和一张写着“请自便”的纸条，旁边有饼干。
words.meaning_cn: phr. 随意；别客气（用于允许或邀请）
words.usage: 固定短语，后接动词原形
words.collocations: feel free to ask, feel free to join, feel free to use

examples.en: Feel free to ask me any questions about the homework.
examples.cn: 关于作业，请随意问我任何问题。

examples.en: Feel free to use my dictionary when you need it.
examples.cn: 你需要时，请随意用我的字典。

socratic_questions.question: 老师对你说“有问题随时可以问我”，用哪个短语表达这种“不用拘束”的意思？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语由“感觉”和“自由”组成，表示让对方放松、随意行动。

sentences: ___ to borrow any book from the shelf.

image_prompts: An airplane touching down on a runway with wheels smoking slightly, sunset sky
A bird perched on a tree branch with wings folded, green leaves around
words.image_desc_en: An airplane landing on a runway with wheel smoke; a bird sitting on a tree branch.
words.image_desc_cn: 一架飞机降落在跑道上，轮子冒烟；一只鸟停在树枝上。
words.meaning_cn: v. 着陆；降落；n. 陆地
words.usage: v. (过去式 landed, 过去分词 landed); n. 不可数名词
words.collocations: land safely, land on, land at

examples.en: The plane will land at the airport in ten minutes.
examples.cn: 飞机将在十分钟后降落在机场。

examples.en: A butterfly landed on the flower in the garden.
examples.cn: 一只蝴蝶降落在花园的花上。

socratic_questions.question: 飞机从天空回到地面，这个动作叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词和“地面”有关，表示从空中到达地面。

sentences: The helicopter ___ on the roof of the hospital.

image_prompts: A close-up of a handwoven African kente cloth with bright yellow, green, and red geometric patterns on a wooden table
A clay pot with traditional African tribal carvings sitting on dry cracked earth under a bright sun
words.image_desc_en: African kente cloth or carved clay pot
words.image_desc_cn: 非洲肯特布或雕刻陶罐
words.usage: adj. / n.
words.collocations: African culture, African wildlife, African country

examples.en: The African elephant has very large ears and a long trunk.
examples.cn: 非洲象有非常大的耳朵和长鼻子。

examples.en: Our class learned about African music and traditional dances.
examples.cn: 我们班学习了非洲音乐和传统舞蹈。

socratic_questions.question: 小明在地理课上看到一张地图，上面标着埃及、肯尼亚和南非。这些国家属于哪个大洲？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这些国家都在非洲，所以用 African 来形容它们的地理位置。

sentences: The ___ savanna is home to lions, giraffes, and zebras.

image_prompts: A single red rose in a clear glass vase on a windowsill with soft morning light filtering through the curtain
A bouquet of pink and white roses tied with a ribbon lying on a wooden picnic table
words.image_desc_en: A red rose in a vase or a bouquet of roses on a table
words.image_desc_cn: 花瓶中的红玫瑰或桌上的玫瑰花束
words.usage: n. (复数 roses)
words.collocations: red rose, rose garden, rose petals
words.preposition_combos: a bunch of roses, rose in bloom

examples.en: My mother loves the smell of fresh roses in the garden.
examples.cn: 我妈妈喜欢花园里新鲜玫瑰的香味。

examples.en: He gave her a single red rose on Valentine's Day.
examples.cn: 他在情人节给了她一朵红玫瑰。

socratic_questions.question: 母亲节快到了，你想送妈妈一种花，它通常代表爱情和美丽，花瓣层层叠叠，还有刺。这是什么花？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种花就是 rose，常见于节日礼物和花园中。

sentences: She picked a beautiful ___ from the garden for her desk.

image_prompts: A large pink peony flower fully bloomed in a ceramic vase on a white table, petals overlapping softly
A peony bush in a sunny garden with deep green leaves and several round buds about to open
words.image_desc_en: A pink peony in a vase or a peony bush in a garden
words.image_desc_cn: 花瓶中的粉色牡丹或花园里的牡丹丛
words.usage: n. (复数 peonies)
words.collocations: peony flower, peony garden, peony season
words.preposition_combos: a peony in bloom, peonies in the garden

examples.en: The peony is often called the king of flowers in China.
examples.cn: 牡丹在中国常被称为花中之王。

examples.en: We saw many beautiful peonies in the park last spring.
examples.cn: 去年春天我们在公园里看到了许多美丽的牡丹。

socratic_questions.question: 语文课上学到一句诗‘唯有牡丹真国色’，这种花花朵很大，颜色鲜艳，被称为富贵花。它是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种花就是 peony，在中国文化中象征富贵和繁荣。

sentences: The ___ in the botanical garden bloomed in late April.

image_prompts: A pink lotus flower floating on a calm pond with large round green leaves and a blue sky reflection
A lotus bud rising above muddy water in a pond, surrounded by lily pads and a dragonfly nearby
words.image_desc_en: A pink lotus on a pond or a lotus bud above muddy water
words.image_desc_cn: 池塘上的粉色莲花或泥水上的莲花花苞
words.usage: n. (复数 lotuses 或 lotus)
words.collocations: lotus flower, lotus pond, lotus leaf
words.preposition_combos: lotus in the pond, lotus on the water

examples.en: The lotus grows in muddy water but stays clean and beautiful.
examples.cn: 莲花生长在泥水中，却保持洁净美丽。

examples.en: We took a boat to see the lotus flowers in the lake.
examples.cn: 我们乘船去看湖里的莲花。

socratic_questions.question: 夏天去公园的池塘边，你会看到一种花从淤泥里长出来，但花瓣很干净，叶子又大又圆。这是什么花？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种花就是 lotus，常用来比喻出淤泥而不染的品质。

sentences: The ___ flower is a symbol of purity in many cultures.

image_prompts: A bright orange and black butterfly resting on a purple flower in a sunny garden, wings fully open
A blue butterfly with white spots perched on a green leaf, morning dew drops on the leaf surface
words.image_desc_en: A butterfly with colorful wings resting on a flower or leaf in nature.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只色彩斑斓的蝴蝶停在花朵或叶子上。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 butterflies)
words.collocations: a beautiful butterfly, catch a butterfly, butterfly wings
words.preposition_combos: butterfly on (a flower), butterfly in (the garden)

examples.en: A beautiful butterfly landed on the yellow flower in the garden.
examples.cn: 一只美丽的蝴蝶落在花园里的黄色花朵上。

examples.en: I saw a blue butterfly flying near the river yesterday morning.
examples.cn: 昨天早上我看见一只蓝色蝴蝶在河边飞。

socratic_questions.question: 小明在公园里看到一种昆虫，它有四片大翅膀，颜色很鲜艳，飞起来很轻快。这是什么昆虫？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种昆虫翅膀大而美丽，常在花丛中飞舞，就是蝴蝶。

sentences: A ___ flew across the garden and landed on a rose.

image_prompts: A close-up of a bird's wing spread wide, showing layered feathers in brown and white
A white paper airplane with one wing folded at an angle, lying on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: A wing of a bird or an object shaped like a wing.
words.image_desc_cn: 鸟类的翅膀或类似翅膀形状的物体。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 wings)
words.collocations: left wing, right wing, bird's wings, airplane wings
words.preposition_combos: wing of (a bird/plane), under the wing

examples.en: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly away.
examples.cn: 那只鸟伤了左翼，飞不走了。

examples.en: The airplane's wings are long and made of strong metal.
examples.cn: 飞机的机翼很长，由坚固的金属制成。

socratic_questions.question: 小华在观察一只受伤的小鸟，发现它有一边身体上的羽毛部分不能动了，导致它飞不起来。是哪个部位出了问题？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 鸟用来飞行的身体部位就是翅膀。

sentences: The eagle spread its ___ wide and soared into the sky.

image_prompts: A green frog sitting on a large lily pad in a pond, water ripples around it
A small brown frog jumping off a wet rock near a stream, splash of water droplets
words.image_desc_en: A frog sitting or jumping near water, with smooth skin and long legs.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只青蛙坐在或跳在水边，皮肤光滑，腿长。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 frogs)
words.collocations: a green frog, jump like a frog, frog in the pond
words.preposition_combos: frog in (the pond), frog on (a leaf)

examples.en: A small green frog jumped into the pond with a splash.
examples.cn: 一只绿色的小青蛙扑通一声跳进了池塘。

examples.en: We saw a frog sitting quietly on a rock near the lake.
examples.cn: 我们看到一只青蛙安静地坐在湖边的岩石上。

socratic_questions.question: 在池塘边，你听到“呱呱”的叫声，然后看到一只绿色的小动物从荷叶上跳进水里。这是什么动物？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种动物生活在水中和陆地，会跳，叫声“呱呱”，就是青蛙。

sentences: The ___ caught a fly with its long tongue in one second.

image_prompts: A stack of books on a desk, the top book reaching up to a ruler marked 30 centimeters
A thermometer outside a window showing the mercury rising up to 38 degrees Celsius
words.image_desc_en: A measurement or limit shown by an object reaching a certain point.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个物体达到某个点或限度，表示测量或上限。
words.usage: prep. (介词短语)
words.collocations: up to ten, up to you, up to now, up to 100

examples.en: You can borrow up to five books from the library each time.
examples.cn: 你每次最多可以从图书馆借五本书。

examples.en: It is up to you to decide which movie we watch tonight.
examples.cn: 由你来决定我们今晚看哪部电影。

socratic_questions.question: 老师说这次考试你可以选择做其中三道题，或者做全部五道题，但最多不能超过五道。老师说的“最多”用英语怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示数量上限的短语是“up to”，意思是“多达”。

sentences: You can spend ___ 50 yuan on the gift for your friend.

image_prompts: A digital kitchen scale showing 250 grams with a red apple on the weighing platform, bright white background
A luggage scale hooked onto a blue suitcase handle, display showing 15.2 kg, airport check-in counter background
words.image_desc_en: A digital scale with an apple on it, displaying weight in grams.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个数字秤上放着一个苹果，显示以克为单位的重量。
words.usage: v. (过去式 weighed, 过去分词 weighed)
words.collocations: weigh oneself, weigh the package, weigh carefully

examples.en: The backpack weighs about five kilograms with all the books.
examples.cn: 这个背包装上所有书后重约五公斤。

examples.en: Please weigh the fruit before putting it into the bag.
examples.cn: 请把水果放进袋子前先称一下重量。

socratic_questions.question: 你想知道这个西瓜有多重，需要用什么动作来得到数字？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作就是放在秤上得到重量数值，不是测量长度或体积。

sentences: The post office worker will ___ the box before shipping.

image_prompts: A black dumbbell with '5 kg' printed in white on the side, resting on a gym floor mat
A digital luggage scale display showing '23.0 kg' with a red suitcase handle in the background
words.image_desc_en: A dumbbell with '5 kg' label on a gym mat.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个哑铃上标有'5 kg'字样，放在健身房地垫上。
words.usage: n. (缩写形式，常与数字连用)
words.collocations: 10 kg, per kg, kg of rice

examples.en: My schoolbag is only three kg this term because I use lighter books.
examples.cn: 这学期我的书包只有三公斤，因为我用了更轻的书。

examples.en: The cat food bag says it contains 1.5 kg of dry food.
examples.cn: 猫粮袋上写着含有1.5公斤干粮。

socratic_questions.question: 超市买米时，袋子上写着'5'后面跟着一个字母缩写，表示重量单位，这个缩写是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是千克的英文缩写，两个字母，常出现在食品和行李标签上。

sentences: The maximum weight for this suitcase is 23 ___.

image_prompts: A single bright yellow ginkgo leaf shaped like a fan lying on a gray stone pavement, autumn sunlight casting shadows
A cluster of fresh green ginkgo leaves on a branch against a clear blue sky, with small round ginkgo fruits visible
words.image_desc_en: A yellow fan-shaped ginkgo leaf on a stone path.
words.image_desc_cn: 一片黄色的扇形银杏叶落在石板路上。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 ginkgoes 或 ginkgos)
words.collocations: ginkgo tree, ginkgo leaf, ginkgo nut
words.preposition_combos: ginkgo in autumn, leaves of ginkgo

examples.en: The ginkgo tree in our school yard turns golden every October.
examples.cn: 我们校园里的银杏树每年十月变成金黄色。

examples.en: I collected a beautiful ginkgo leaf and pressed it in my notebook.
examples.cn: 我捡了一片漂亮的银杏叶，夹在笔记本里。

socratic_questions.question: 秋天校园里有一种树，叶子像小扇子，变成金黄色很漂亮，这是什么树？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种树的叶子形状独特，像打开的扇子，秋天会变成明亮的黄色。

sentences: The ___ leaves on the ground looked like a golden carpet.

image_prompts: A handwritten note on a desk saying 'You can do it!' next to a cup of hot tea and a glowing lamp
A stack of books with a bookmark sticking out, on top a small sign reading 'Dream Big' in colorful letters
words.image_desc_en: A motivational note on a desk with a warm lamp and tea.
words.image_desc_cn: 书桌上有一张鼓励便条，旁边是温暖的台灯和热茶。
words.usage: v. (过去式 believed, 过去分词 believed)
words.collocations: believe in, believe it or not, strongly believe

examples.en: I believe practice makes perfect, so I keep trying every day.
examples.cn: 我相信熟能生巧，所以我每天都坚持练习。

examples.en: Do you believe the weather report says it will rain tomorrow?
examples.cn: 你相信天气预报说明天会下雨吗？

socratic_questions.question: 朋友告诉你他每天练琴两小时，你心里觉得他说的是真的，这个心理活动叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动词表示内心接受某件事是真的，和'怀疑'意思相反。

sentences: I ___ that hard work leads to good results.

image_prompts: A large map of China with several provinces highlighted in different colors, each with a capital city marked by a star
A wooden signpost at a highway border reading 'Welcome to Sichuan Province' with mountains in the background
words.image_desc_en: A map of China with colored provinces and a border signpost for a province.

words.collocations: take a walk after dinner, take a walk in the park, go for a walk

words.collocations: connect A to B, connect with, connect online

examples.en: This bridge connects the two sides of the city.

examples.en: We can connect with friends through video calls.
examples.cn: 我们可以通过视频通话与朋友联系。

socratic_questions.question: 你想把手机和电脑用数据线连起来传照片，这个动作叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 让两个设备之间建立联系，叫‘连接’。

words.usage: 形容词 adj. (由动词 connect 的过去分词转化而来)
words.collocations: be connected to, stay connected, well-connected

examples.en: My phone is connected to the Wi-Fi network now.
examples.cn: 我的手机现在连接到了Wi-Fi网络。

socratic_questions.question: 你的平板电脑已经能上网了，屏幕上显示‘已联网’，这个状态用哪个词形容？

sentences: Make sure the laptop is ___ to the power source before use.

image_prompts: Two puzzle pieces fitting together on a wooden table, soft natural light
A network of glowing fiber optic cables linking multiple servers in a dark data center
words.image_desc_en: Two puzzle pieces interlocking on a wooden surface, or glowing cables linking servers.
words.image_desc_cn: 两块拼图在木桌上咬合，或发光光缆连接服务器。

words.preposition_combos: be connected with (后接名词或代词)

examples.en: Your success is connected with your daily hard work.
examples.cn: 你的成功与你每天的辛勤工作有关。

examples.en: This museum is connected with the local history.
examples.cn: 这个博物馆与当地历史有关联。

socratic_questions.question: 你想说“我的头痛和昨晚没睡好有关”，但不想用“because of”，可以用哪个短语表示两者有关联？

sentences: The accident ___ the driver's carelessness.

image_prompts: A cup of black coffee on a white saucer, no sugar cubes or cream nearby
An empty bird nest on a bare tree branch in winter, no eggs or birds inside
words.image_desc_en: A cup of black coffee with no sugar or cream, or an empty bird nest on a branch.
words.image_desc_cn: 一杯不加糖不加奶的黑咖啡，或树枝上空空的鸟巢。
words.usage: 介词 (prep.)，后接名词、代词或动名词。
words.collocations: without doubt, without help, go without

examples.en: She finished the test without any mistakes.
examples.cn: 她完成了测试，没有任何错误。

examples.en: We can't live without clean water and fresh air.
examples.cn: 没有干净的水和新鲜的空气，我们无法生存。

socratic_questions.question: 你想说“他一句话没说就走了”，强调“没有”做某件事，应该用哪个介词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个介词表示“缺乏”或“不伴随”，后面常接名词或动名词。

sentences: He left the room ___ saying goodbye.

image_prompts: A sketchbook open to a page with a drawing of a flying castle among clouds, pencil nearby
A glass jar half-filled with colorful paper stars, soft glow from a desk lamp

words.image_desc_cn: 一本打开的素描本，画着云中的飞行城堡，或一罐彩色纸星星。

words.collocations: imagine doing sth., imagine that...

examples.en: Can you imagine living on another planet one day?
examples.cn: 你能想象有一天生活在另一个星球上吗？

examples.en: I imagine the party will be a lot of fun.
examples.cn: 我设想这个聚会会很有趣。

socratic_questions.question: 你想说“我无法想象没有手机的生活”，表达在脑海里形成画面或想法，该用哪个动词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动词表示在脑海中创造或设想某种情景，常与“can't”连用。

sentences: It's hard to ___ a world without books.

image_prompts: A thick green carpet of moss covering the cracks of an old stone wall in a forest

words.image_desc_en: Green moss covering an old stone wall, or moss on a damp tree trunk with dewdrops.

words.collocations: green moss, soft moss, covered with moss
words.preposition_combos: moss on + n., covered with moss

examples.en: The old stones in the garden are covered with soft moss.
examples.cn: 花园里的旧石头上覆盖着柔软的苔藓。

examples.en: Moss grows well in wet and shady places.
examples.cn: 苔藓在潮湿阴暗的地方长得很好。

socratic_questions.question: 你想描述森林里一块潮湿的石头上长满了绿色的细小植物，这种植物叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一种生长在阴湿环境中的小型绿色植物，没有真正的根和花，常覆盖在石头或树干上。

sentences: The north side of the tree trunk was covered with thick ___.

socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种树以颜色和高度闻名，名字里带有‘红’和‘木’的意思。

sentences: The ancient ___ tree in the forest is over a thousand years old.

words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 cheetahs)

words.preposition_combos: a cheetah in the wild; the speed of a cheetah

examples.cn: 猎豹的斑点帮助它隐藏在长草丛中。

socratic_questions.question: 家里要野餐，需要带一种可以收起来、不占空间的桌子和椅子。这种桌子和椅子有什么特点？

socratic_questions.question: 在班级话剧里，有人演公主，有人演骑士，每个人都有自己的什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是 role，指角色或职责。

words.preposition_combos: a handful of peas, peas in a pod

socratic_questions.question: 妈妈做了一道菜，里面有一种小小的、圆圆的、绿色的蔬菜，吃起来有点甜。这种蔬菜是什么？

words.image_desc_cn: 烈日下沙丘连绵的炎热沙漠；灰色天空下漂浮着冰山的极地水域。

examples.en: Many animals cannot survive in a very dry climate.

socratic_questions.question: 地理课上老师问：一个地区多年平均的天气状况，比如是炎热还是寒冷、干燥还是湿润，这叫什么？

A plate of cookies with one cookie missing from the center, crumbs around the empty spot
words.image_desc_en: A set of pencils with one isolated from the group, or a plate of cookies with one missing.
words.image_desc_cn: 一组铅笔中有一支单独分开，或一盘饼干中缺了一块。
words.usage: prep. 介词
words.collocations: except for, except that, all except

examples.en: All the students passed the exam except Tom.
examples.cn: 除了汤姆，所有学生都通过了考试。

examples.en: I like all subjects except math this term.
examples.cn: 这学期除了数学，我喜欢所有科目。

socratic_questions.question: 老师说全班都交了作业，但小明没交。你想说‘除了小明，大家都交了作业’，该用哪个词表示‘除了’？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示排除某人或某物，常用于‘全部……除了……’的句型。

sentences: Everyone went to the park ___ John, who was sick.

image_prompts: A neatly organized desk with a stack of textbooks, a pencil case, and a printed schedule titled 'SAT Prep' in bright lighting
A whiteboard covered with math formulas and English grammar notes, an eraser and markers nearby, study room setting
words.image_desc_en: A study desk with textbooks and a prep schedule, or a whiteboard with academic notes.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张放有教科书和备考计划表的书桌，或一块写满学术笔记的白板。
words.meaning_cn: 准备；备考（名词，常指考试准备）
words.usage: n. (不可数名词，常与考试名称连用，如 SAT prep, exam prep)
words.collocations: exam prep, test prep, prep class, prep time
words.preposition_combos: prep for (e.g., prep for the final exam)

examples.en: I need to do some prep for the math test tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我需要为明天的数学考试做些准备。

examples.en: Our school offers a special prep class for the English exam.
examples.cn: 我们学校为英语考试开设了专门的备考班。

socratic_questions.question: 你下周要参加一场重要的英语考试，现在你正在整理笔记和练习题，这个行为叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是 preparation 的缩写，常出现在考试相关的场景中，比如 'exam prep'。

sentences: She spent the whole weekend doing ___ for the science competition.

image_prompts: A miniature ceramic teapot next to a full-sized teacup on a wooden table, extreme size contrast
A single grain of rice on a dark surface, photographed with macro lens showing fine texture
words.image_desc_en: A very small teapot beside a normal cup, or a single rice grain magnified.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个极小的茶壶放在正常尺寸的杯子旁边，或一粒放大的米粒。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 tinier, 最高级 tiniest)
words.collocations: tiny house, tiny bit, tiny piece, tiny spot
words.preposition_combos: tiny in size, tiny for (e.g., tiny for its age)

examples.en: There is a tiny spider in the corner of the window.
examples.cn: 窗户角落有一只极小的蜘蛛。

examples.en: She added just a tiny bit of sugar to her coffee.
examples.cn: 她只在咖啡里加了一点点糖。

socratic_questions.question: 你在草丛里发现了一朵花，它比你的指甲盖还小，你会用什么词形容它的大小？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示 '非常小'，比 small 的程度更强，常用来描述细节或迷你物品。

sentences: The kitten was so ___ that it could fit in a teacup.

image_prompts: A bustling outdoor market with colorful fruit stalls, hanging lanterns, and people walking between stands, bright daylight
A group of colorful birds perched on a tree branch, some with wings spread, against a blue sky
words.image_desc_en: A busy market with colorful stalls and lanterns, or birds on a branch with active poses.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个热闹的彩色市场挂着灯笼，或树枝上姿态活跃的彩色鸟群。
words.meaning_cn: 充满活力的；热闹的；生动的
words.usage: adj. (比较级 livelier, 最高级 liveliest; 副词形式 livelily 较少用)
words.collocations: lively discussion, lively music, lively atmosphere, lively street

examples.en: The street market was lively with music and laughter.
examples.cn: 街头市场充满了音乐和笑声，非常热闹。

examples.en: We had a lively discussion about our favorite movies.
examples.cn: 我们就最喜欢的电影进行了一场热烈的讨论。

socratic_questions.question: 你走进一个公园，看到很多人在跳舞、唱歌、放风筝，气氛非常欢乐，你会怎么形容这个场景？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述充满能量和活力的状态，常用来形容气氛、讨论或音乐。

sentences: The party became more ___ when the band started playing.

image_prompts: A vast snowy landscape with icebergs floating in dark blue water under a pale sky, no people visible
A polar bear walking on a sheet of ice with distant mountains covered in snow, clear cold light
words.image_desc_en: A snowy landscape with icebergs and dark water, or a polar bear on ice with snowy mountains.
words.image_desc_cn: 一片冰雪覆盖的景色，冰山漂浮在深蓝海面上，或一只北极熊走在冰面上，远处是雪山。
words.usage: n. (专有名词，常带定冠词 the；形容词形式 Arctic)
words.collocations: the Arctic Ocean, the Arctic Circle, Arctic ice, Arctic wildlife
words.preposition_combos: in the Arctic, from the Arctic, to the Arctic

examples.en: The Arctic is one of the coldest places on Earth.
examples.cn: 北极是地球上最寒冷的地方之一。

examples.en: Many scientists study the ice melting in the Arctic.
examples.cn: 许多科学家研究北极冰层融化。

socratic_questions.question: 地球的最北端是一片冰雪覆盖的区域，那里有北极熊和冰山，这个区域叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一个地理专有名词，以 'the' 开头，指代地球顶端的寒冷地区。

sentences: Temperatures in ___ can drop below -50°C in winter.

image_prompts: A glass jar filled with golden liquid honey, light shining through it onto a wooden table, no people
A close-up of a honeycomb dripping with thick golden honey onto a white plate, no insects or people
words.image_desc_en: A jar of golden honey on a wooden surface, with a honey dipper resting beside it.
words.image_desc_cn: 一罐金色蜂蜜放在木桌上，旁边放着一根蜂蜜棒。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: a jar of honey, taste like honey, sweet as honey

examples.en: I like to put a spoon of honey in my tea.
examples.cn: 我喜欢在茶里放一勺蜂蜜。

examples.en: This cake tastes sweet because it has honey inside.
examples.cn: 这块蛋糕尝起来很甜，因为里面加了蜂蜜。

socratic_questions.question: 妈妈做蛋糕时，不想用白糖，想用一种天然的、金黄色的甜味代替品，这是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是一种由蜜蜂采集花蜜制成的天然甜味物质。

sentences: The tea tastes better if you add some ___.

image_prompts: A single wilted flower in a cracked vase on a rainy windowsill, raindrops on the glass, no people
A torn birthday card lying on a table next to an unlit candle, no people
words.image_desc_en: A wilted flower in a cracked vase, with raindrops on a window behind it.
words.image_desc_cn: 一朵枯萎的花插在破裂的花瓶里，身后窗户上挂着雨滴。
words.usage: adj. (形容词，常与 be/get/feel 连用)
words.collocations: feel disappointed, be disappointed with, look disappointed

examples.en: She felt disappointed when the game was cancelled.
examples.cn: 当比赛被取消时，她感到很失望。

examples.en: My parents were disappointed with my test result.
examples.cn: 我的父母对我的考试成绩感到失望。

socratic_questions.question: 你期待了很久的周末露营，结果因为下雨取消了。你心里是什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是期望落空后那种不开心、沮丧的情绪。

sentences: Tom was ___ because he didn't win the first prize.

image_prompts: Two puzzle pieces fitting together perfectly on a white table, no hands or people
A network of glowing lines connecting several dots on a dark digital screen, no people
words.image_desc_en: Two jigsaw puzzle pieces interlocking on a white surface.
words.image_desc_cn: 两块拼图在白色表面上完美地咬合在一起。
words.usage: n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: have a connection, build a connection, lose connection

examples.en: There is a strong connection between exercise and health.
examples.cn: 锻炼和健康之间有很强的联系。

examples.en: My phone lost the connection during the call.
examples.cn: 我的手机在通话过程中断线了。

socratic_questions.question: 你在写一篇关于‘友谊’的作文，想表达‘我和好朋友之间有一种特别的纽带’，可以用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示两件事或两个人之间的关联或纽带。

sentences: The Internet ___ was very slow, so I couldn't watch the video.

image_prompts: A close-up of a bee landing on a bright yellow sunflower, pollen grains visible on its legs, golden sunlight
A butterfly perched on a pink flower, tiny pollen particles floating in the air, soft morning light
words.image_desc_en: A bee on a sunflower with pollen grains; a butterfly on a pink flower with floating pollen.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只蜜蜂在向日葵上，花粉颗粒可见；一只蝴蝶停在粉色花朵上，花粉漂浮。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: cross-pollination, wind pollination, insect pollination
words.preposition_combos: pollination by bees, pollination of flowers

examples.en: Bees play a key role in the pollination of fruit trees.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂在果树的授粉中起着关键作用。

examples.en: Wind pollination is common among grasses and many trees.
examples.cn: 风媒传粉在草类和许多树木中很常见。

socratic_questions.question: 春天花园里，蜜蜂在花间飞来飞去，它们其实在帮花朵完成一件重要的事，这件事叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词和花粉、花朵繁殖有关，是蜜蜂帮助花朵的过程。

sentences: Without ___, many plants cannot produce fruits or seeds.

image_prompts: A macro shot of a flower stamen covered in fine yellow powder, bright natural light
A glass slide under a microscope showing tiny round pollen grains, blue-tinted background
words.image_desc_en: Yellow powder on a flower stamen; microscopic view of round pollen grains.
words.image_desc_cn: 花朵雄蕊上的黄色粉末；显微镜下圆形花粉颗粒的视图。
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: pollen grains, pollen allergy, pollen count
words.preposition_combos: covered with pollen, pollen from flowers

examples.en: The yellow powder on the flower is called pollen.
examples.cn: 花上的黄色粉末叫做花粉。

examples.en: High pollen levels can cause sneezing and itchy eyes.
examples.cn: 高花粉水平会导致打喷嚏和眼睛发痒。

socratic_questions.question: 春天有些人会打喷嚏、流鼻涕，医生说是因为空气中飘着一种细小的黄色粉末，这种粉末叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词是植物繁殖时产生的细粉，常引起过敏。

sentences: Bees collect ___ from flowers to make honey.

image_prompts: A hand pressing a red emergency stop button on a machine, bright warning sign nearby
A stack of books with a sticky note reading 'Take action now!' on a wooden desk
words.image_desc_en: A hand pressing a red stop button; a sticky note saying 'Take action now!' on books.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只手按下红色停止按钮；一张写着‘立即行动’的便签贴在书上。
words.usage: n. (可数/不可数名词)
words.collocations: take action, action plan, in action, action movie

examples.en: We need to take action to protect the environment.
examples.cn: 我们需要采取行动来保护环境。

examples.en: His quick action saved the cat from the tree.
examples.cn: 他的快速行动把猫从树上救了下来。

socratic_questions.question: 看到地上有垃圾，你弯腰捡起来扔进垃圾桶，这个具体的做法可以用哪个词概括？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指做某件事的具体行为或步骤，不是空想。

sentences: The firefighter's brave ___ saved many lives.

image_prompts: A whiteboard with '2+2=5' crossed out and '2+2=4' written below, red marker correction
A newspaper headline on a table: 'Myth Busted: The Truth Revealed' with a magnifying glass
words.image_desc_en: A whiteboard with a wrong math equation corrected; a newspaper headline about truth.
words.image_desc_cn: 白板上被划掉的错误数学等式和正确写法；关于真相的报纸头条。
words.usage: adv. phrase (副词短语，用于强调事实或纠正误解)
words.collocations: in fact, ...; ... in fact

examples.en: He looks young, but in fact he is over forty.
examples.cn: 他看起来年轻，但实际上他已经四十多岁了。

examples.en: Many people think spiders are insects. In fact, they are not.
examples.cn: 很多人认为蜘蛛是昆虫。事实上，它们不是。

socratic_questions.question: 有人说企鹅生活在北极，但你知道这是错的，你想纠正这个说法，可以用哪个短语开头？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语用来引出真实情况，通常前面的话是错的或片面的。

sentences: Some believe the earth is flat, but ___ it is round.

image_prompts: A pie chart on a whiteboard showing 75% shaded in blue, with a marker resting nearby
A digital calculator display showing the number 50 followed by a percent symbol, on a wooden desk
words.image_desc_en: A pie chart with 75% shaded blue on a whiteboard, marker nearby; a calculator showing 50% on a wooden desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 白板上一个75%蓝色区域的饼图，旁边有记号笔；木桌上计算器显示50%。
words.usage: n. (常作单数) 百分比；每百中
words.collocations: a large/small per cent; per cent of; 100 per cent

examples.en: About 80 per cent of the students passed the math exam.
examples.cn: 大约80%的学生通过了数学考试。

examples.en: The store offers a 20 per cent discount on all shoes.
examples.cn: 这家店所有鞋子打八折。

socratic_questions.question: 老师问全班有多少人完成了作业，班长说‘几乎全部，只有少数没交’。如果全班50人，48人交了，班长可以说‘交了作业的人占全班____？’
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示‘每百个中有多少个’时用 per cent，这里48/50=96%，所以是96 per cent。

sentences: Only ten ___ of the population live in that area.

image_prompts: A cracked smartphone screen with a rain cloud drawn above it, and a sign saying 'No water nearby'
A wilted plant next to a dry watering can, with a note reading 'Forgot to water'
words.image_desc_en: A cracked smartphone with a rain cloud drawn above and a 'No water' sign; a wilted plant beside a dry watering can with a note.
words.image_desc_cn: 一部屏幕碎裂的手机，上方画着雨云和‘禁止水’标志；一株枯萎植物旁边是干水壶和便条。
words.usage: adv. phrase 连接因果关系的副词短语
words.collocations: for this reason, ...; for this reason alone

examples.en: The library is very quiet. For this reason, I often study there.
examples.cn: 图书馆非常安静。因此，我常在那里学习。

examples.en: He forgot his umbrella. For this reason, he got wet in the rain.
examples.cn: 他忘了带伞，因此被雨淋湿了。

socratic_questions.question: 小明因为早上起晚了，错过了校车，最后迟到了。你想用一句话总结原因和结果，可以说‘他起晚了，____他迟到了。’这里该填什么短语？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示‘因为这个原因’引出结果，用 for this reason，相当于‘所以’。

sentences: The movie was boring. ___, we left early.

image_prompts: A round blue-and-green globe floating in dark space with tiny stars around it
A solar system model with eight colorful planets orbiting a yellow sun on a classroom shelf
words.image_desc_en: A blue-green globe floating in dark starry space; a solar system model with eight planets around a yellow sun on a shelf.
words.image_desc_cn: 深色星空中漂浮的蓝绿色球体；书架上太阳系模型，八颗行星环绕黄色太阳。
words.usage: n. (可数名词) 行星
words.collocations: the planet Earth; protect the planet; on the planet
words.preposition_combos: on the planet; around the planet

examples.en: Earth is the third planet from the sun in our solar system.
examples.cn: 地球是太阳系中离太阳第三近的行星。

examples.en: We should recycle plastic to help protect the planet.
examples.cn: 我们应该回收塑料来帮助保护地球。

socratic_questions.question: 在科学课上，老师展示了一张图片：一个蓝色和绿色相间的球体，周围有云层。老师说‘这是我们居住的____’，请问这个空填什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 我们居住的星球叫地球，地球是一颗行星，所以填 planet。

sentences: Mars is a red ___ in the night sky.

image_prompts: A closed book with a bookmark sticking out, next to a cup of tea and a note saying 'Pass the test'
A pair of running shoes placed neatly beside a stopwatch on a track, with a sign reading 'Win the race'
words.image_desc_en: A closed book with a bookmark, tea cup, and a note 'Pass the test'; running shoes beside a stopwatch on a track with a 'Win the race' sign.
words.image_desc_cn: 合上的书插着书签，旁边有茶杯和写着‘通过考试’的便条；跑道上跑鞋旁有秒表和‘赢得比赛’标志。
words.usage: prep. phrase 后接动词原形，表示目的
words.collocations: in order to do sth.; in order to achieve; in order to get
words.preposition_combos: in order to + 动词原形

examples.en: She studies hard in order to get good grades in exams.
examples.cn: 她努力学习，以便在考试中取得好成绩。

examples.en: We turn off the lights in order to save electricity.
examples.cn: 我们关灯是为了省电。

socratic_questions.question: 你想告诉朋友你每天早起的原因——因为你想赶上第一班公交车。你可以说‘我每天早起____赶上第一班车。’这里该填什么短语？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示‘为了’某个目的，用 in order to，后面接动词原形。

sentences: He exercises every day ___ stay healthy.

image_prompts: A neatly arranged grocery store shelf with colorful cereal boxes and canned goods under bright fluorescent lights
A wooden storage chest in a dusty attic filled with old books and folded blankets, sunlight streaming through a small window
words.image_desc_en: A grocery store shelf or a storage chest in an attic.
words.image_desc_cn: 超市货架或阁楼里的储物箱。
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 stored, 过去分词 stored)
words.collocations: department store, grocery store, store up, store away

examples.en: We need to buy milk from the corner store today.
examples.cn: 我们今天需要从街角商店买牛奶。

examples.en: She will store her winter clothes in a big box.
examples.cn: 她会把冬衣储存在一个大箱子里。

socratic_questions.question: 你想把暑假读过的旧杂志放在一个地方保存起来，这个地方叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词既可以指买东西的地方，也可以指把东西收起来的地方。

sentences: Please ___ the leftover food in the fridge before it goes bad.

image_prompts: A close-up of a golden honeycomb with hexagonal wax cells dripping with honey on a wooden table
A cross-section of a beehive showing multiple layers of honeycomb structure inside a glass observation box
words.image_desc_en: A honeycomb with hexagonal cells and dripping honey.
words.image_desc_cn: 带有六边形蜂巢和滴落蜂蜜的蜂巢。
words.usage: n.
words.collocations: honeycomb structure, honeycomb pattern, honeycomb of cells

examples.en: The honeycomb is made of many small hexagonal cells.
examples.cn: 蜂巢由许多小的六边形蜂室组成。

examples.en: Bees store honey inside the honeycomb for winter.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂把蜂蜜储存在蜂巢里过冬。

socratic_questions.question: 蜜蜂把蜂蜜放在一个有很多小格子的东西里，每个格子都是六边形的，这个东西叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词听起来像“蜂蜜”和“梳子”的组合，是蜜蜂的家。

sentences: The beekeeper carefully removed the ___ from the hive.

image_prompts: Two smartphones on a table with glowing chat bubbles and a green call icon between them
A whiteboard covered with colorful sticky notes and arrows connecting different ideas
words.image_desc_en: Two phones with chat bubbles or a whiteboard with sticky notes.
words.image_desc_cn: 两部带有聊天气泡的手机或贴满便利贴的白板。
words.usage: v. (过去式 communicated, 过去分词 communicated)
words.collocations: communicate with, communicate ideas, communicate clearly

examples.en: We can communicate with friends by sending emails.
examples.cn: 我们可以通过发送电子邮件与朋友交流。

examples.en: Good teams communicate their ideas during meetings.
examples.cn: 好的团队在会议中交流他们的想法。

socratic_questions.question: 你和朋友不在同一个城市，但你想告诉对方你最近的心情，你们可以通过什么方式传递信息？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示把想法或信息传递给对方，不一定是面对面说话。

sentences: It is important to ___ clearly when working in a group.

image_prompts: A theater stage with a single spotlight shining on an empty wooden chair and a script on the floor
A jigsaw puzzle with one piece being placed into the center of the completed picture
words.image_desc_en: A stage with a spotlight and script, or a jigsaw puzzle piece being placed.
words.image_desc_cn: 聚光灯下的舞台和剧本，或正在拼入的拼图块。
words.usage: v. phrase (过去式 played a part, 过去分词 played a part)
words.collocations: play a part in, play an important part, play a leading part

examples.en: Everyone should play a part in keeping the classroom clean.
examples.cn: 每个人都应该在保持教室清洁方面发挥作用。

examples.en: Sunlight plays a part in helping plants grow strong.
examples.cn: 阳光在帮助植物茁壮成长方面起作用。

socratic_questions.question: 学校要举办环保活动，每个同学都需要做一些事情来帮助活动成功，这可以用什么短语来形容？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语字面意思是“扮演一个部分”，实际指参与并做出贡献。

sentences: Teamwork ___ in winning the basketball game.

image_prompts: A dense forest with sunlight filtering through leaves, a small stream flowing over rocks, moss on tree trunks, no people visible.
